commits.message: Update README.md
Create README.md
Create LICENSE
Correct the implementation of the BizarroSwap instruction.
Correct the loading of the third list of filter chains in multidependent picture lumps.

Make a few corrections to misc/compare/meshhero.doc. "Click to make several moves" had already been implemented, but this file incorrectly claimed that it didn't; the incorrect statement has been removed. No changes to code.
Start of implementation of the (Trigger) block (currently only syntax is implemented) to control timing/ordering of some events.
Make control and middle button to draw lines from clicked location for helping with alignment.
Change colour of (X,Y) coordinates to make it easier to read.
Implement SHIFT+DELETE to delete moves up to the mark.
Implement save state slots, including loading personal best solutions.
Add the ^? command (which is used only for debugging and may be changed in future).
Implement shift+leftclick to try to move Hero the number of steps toward where it is clicked, similar to the MESH:Hero.
Make CTRL+DEL to delete all moves ahead of the current point in the move list, as described in a note in the HEARTS1 puzzle set.
Add misc/compare/zzt_megazeux.doc
Add the (Pc) block (counting pattern block).
Improve the file of comparison of MESH:Hero, and also add file comparing with PuzzleScript.
Move meshhero.doc to another directory and add more details.
Move the differences of MESH:Hero into a separate document.
Correct a mistake in edit.c so that it does not mistakenly use RLE if the object's Dir variable is different than the previous object.
Add stuff to tutorial document. (Hopefully it is better now?)
Add incomplete tutorial document file. (Hopefully can be improved in future)
Add CancelTriggers and DeferTriggers instructions.
Add some additional checks to JumpTo for Compatible classes only. This fixes three levels, one each in HEARTS1, HEARTS4, and SUPERHRO.
Implement ,if ,while ,until instructions (conditions with keeping the value in the stack if it is nonzero)
Implement the / and ,/ commands in pattern blocks.
The portalled Matrix chat is no longer available, so change the documentation to mention that it is not available.
Add 'rS' to set replay speed to a number with absolute instead of relative setting.
Change tron8to32 to handle multibyte characters only if has_mbcs is true.
Functions to convert between TRON-8 and TRON-32 (may be used in future for the text editor; currently unused, and may be removed if it is found to be unnecessary)
Implement new SQL functions GAMEOVER, LEVEL_CODE, and LEVEL_VERSION.
Correct some mistakes in the dealing with multibyte characters.
Add WARPED message.
Implement (untested and incomplete) MBCS character substitutions in popups in exec.c.
Begin to implement multibyte character codes (it is not enough to be used, so far)
Fix {edit <number>} so that it replaces the entire argument if it begins with an opening delimiter ("{" or "(").
Implement CONFIG_OMIT_INCLUDE
Correct a memory leak in the recent change to the {edit} macro
Allow arguments to numeric arithmetic/bitwise macros to be directions and keys as well as numbers.
Add the variant of the {edit} macro to edit an argument of a macro which is currently being expanded.
Optimize message blocks that begin with a goto instruction to a label that comes before it.
Add 'mm' binding ALT with middle mouse button to write coordinates to the Misc value of MRU.
SHIFT+B in editor to fill only the border of the selection rectangle.
Correct a mistake in the GitHub Actions file.
Add GitHub Actions file to auto assignment issues from GitHub.
More documentation improvements, including README and some minor changes in other files.
Documentation improvements (no code changes).
Add .codepage.ignore option.
Mention the GitHub mirror in the README file.
Change har.c so that wildcards can be used.
Update PORTING file (use of JavaScript codes in compiling).
Some improvements in PORTING file.

Fix a mistake in mbtofhm.c, and document ImageSeq and ImageLoop (presumably, they were used in the MESH:Hero engine before Animate was implemented; a few puzzle sets use them, though; in future they will also be implemented in Free Hero Mesh)
Implement CONFIG_FUNCTION_ASK_TEXT (full code page capability is not implemented in this function; this may be fixed in future)
Additions to FAQ.

Implement returning classes/objects from COLLIDEBY message to transform objects.
(Not fully tested yet)
Implement LastR, NextR, ThisR; this is not tested and not fully complete; it will be used in future to implement replacing objects with new ones in COLLIDE and COLLIDEBY messages.

Do not hard code number of pictures per row in the internal representation; use macros instead.
This number is increased from 16 to 128 in order to avoid coordinate overflows for puzzle sets with large number of pictures if a large picture size is selected.
TODO features; not implemented yet
Enhancements to (PopUp) to use arrays; new Quiz and ,Quiz commands to set quiz_obj; bug fix for the case where quiz_obj has been destroyed.
Implement the conditional blocks in (PopUp) texts.

Add a "S" column to the "GRAPH" SQL table in the picture editor.
The example ALT+M macro uses this to automatically apply horizontal mirror symmetry to a picture.
Fix the implementation of ranges in (DefaultImage) block
Minor documentation improvements.
Fix a mistake in the compile script; the level table loading means that function.c also depends on instruc.h, so delete function.o if instruc.h is newer.
Implement retz and retnz instruction
Add a Replace instruction.
Implement hue/shade filter in dependent pictures.
Implement level hashes calculation.
Ensure that class/message names made by {make} do not contain invalid characters.
Implement CONFIG_EXTRA_SCREEN_INIT
Implement CONFIG_NO_STATUS
Implement CONFIG_OMIT_SOUND
Fix a mistake in picedit.c with freeing memory after saving a multidependent picture.

The previous attempted fix of trying to call a macro whose definition is empty had a problem with defining new macros. Instead, make a macro with a single TF_MACRO+TF_ABNORMAL token if it is empty, and skip the TF_MACRO+TF_ABNORMAL token during expansion.
Fix the {include} macro file name dealing (to allow lowercase letters), and fix the case of trying to call a macro whose definition is empty.
Implement /mod and ,/mod commands

Add a few functions into picture.c for dealing with multibyte encodings and font sizes other than 8x8; however, this feature is not implemented yet, and only one of these functions is implemented so far.

Fix the version_change logic in edit.c to work with the new user state format.
(It no longer works with the old format, although it will automatically be upgraded in game.c anyways, so it is unlikely to need to work with the old format.)
Finish the implementation of multidependent pictures.
Implement editing multidependent pictures; also improve comconfig.doc (independently)
Start to implement multidependent picture lumps (currently only adding/deleting them in the picture editor and listing them; you cannot edit nor use them yet).
Check if sqlite3_column_text returns a null pointer, in the levels_column function in game.c.

Implement (partially) comconfig; also add back into game.c the ability to record solution timestamps (that was removed by mistake in the past), and improve documentation about compiling (in README file).
Change some dealing with IMG/DEP lumps; in future the MUL lumps may also be implemented.
Implement the global (Density) block.
If sqlite3.o is not present, try to automatically compile sqlite3.c if it is present.
Improve compilation instructions and script to check for a common mistake.
Improvements and corrections of pattern matching capability.
Allow the (Order) list to contain class names and message names.
Implementation of order of execution overriding is probably corrected now.
Add a paragraph in PORTING file, about alternative implementations that do not use SQLite and X resource manager.
Add the documentation about coordinate input binding into the bindings.doc file.
Implement coordinate input.

Several changes needed to allow coordinate input to be implemented in future (including the CLICK message and InputXY keyword).
Also fixes a bug that was caused by changing MoveItem from Uint8 to Uint16.
Implement crushing (similar to pieces being crushed in ZZT if they cannot be pushed).
Implement -O switch to output private solutions on stdout.
Change MoveItem to Uint16 and fix the encoders/decoders for future use (only numbers 8 to 255 are currently in use).
More improvements to PORTING file.
Add PORTING file (currently incomplete)
